steps.name: Read the annotations of this run
steps.run:
python3 -I - <<'PY'
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time

repo, run_id = os.environ["REPO"], os.environ["RUN_ID"]
NOTICE = re.compile(r"deprecat", re.I)


def api(path):
    for attempt in range(3):
        done = subprocess.run(["gh", "api", "--paginate", path], capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
        if done.returncode == 0:
            # --paginate prints one JSON document per page, back to back
            pages, text, at = [], done.stdout, 0
            decoder = json.JSONDecoder()
            while at < len(text):
                if text[at].isspace():
                    at += 1
                    continue
                page, at = decoder.raw_decode(text, at)
                pages.append(page)
            return pages
        time.sleep(2 * (attempt + 1))
    print(f"::error::could not read {path}: {done.stderr.strip()}")
    sys.exit(1)


jobs = [job for page in api(f"repos/{repo}/actions/runs/{run_id}/jobs?per_page=100") for job in page["jobs"]]
found = []
for job in jobs:
    for page in api(f"repos/{repo}/check-runs/{job['id']}/annotations?per_page=100"):
        for note in page:
            if note.get("annotation_level") in ("warning", "failure") and NOTICE.search(note.get("message") or ""):
                found.append((job["name"], note["message"].strip().splitlines()[0]))
for name, message in found:
    print(f"::error::{name}: {message}")
if found:
    sys.exit(1)
print(f"No deprecation notice in {len(jobs)} jobs.")
PY

steps.name: Check direct file counts with the base gate
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
script="$RUNNER_TEMP/folder-limit.sh"
if [ -z "$BASE" ]; then
  cp scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh "$script"
else
  base="$(git rev-parse --verify "${BASE}^{commit}")"
  git ls-tree --name-only "$base" -- scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh >"$RUNNER_TEMP/folder-limit-base-path"
  if [ -s "$RUNNER_TEMP/folder-limit-base-path" ]; then
    git show "$base:scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh" >"$script"
  else
    echo "base has no folder-limit gate; using PR copy for its first introduction" >&2
    cp scripts/folder-limit/folder-limit.sh "$script"
  fi
fi
bash "$script"

gate.name: ${{ github.event_name == 'merge_group' && 'CI gate' || github.event_name == 'pull_request' && (github.event.pull_request.base.ref == 'main' && 'CI gate (main)' || 'CI gate') || format('CI gate ({0})', github.event_name) }}
